info.title: IDFRI Local API
info.summary: IDFRI Local API：由正在运行的 IDFRI 提供、兼容 AdsPower 的本地 HTTP API。
info.description:
IDFRI 只在回环接口（http://127.0.0.1:50400）提供此 API。每次启动都会生成随机 256 位 Token；所有请求必须携带 `Authorization: Bearer <token>`，并通过严格的 Host 与 Origin 校验。认证失败返回 HTTP 401，来源校验失败返回 HTTP 403。不要通过反向代理、端口转发或隧道暴露此监听器。`browserStart` 或 `browserActive` 返回的 CDP WebSocket URL 可以完全控制浏览器及登录会话，应按凭据保护。

该 API 是 AdsPower Local API 的兼容子集，已有客户端只需更改基础 URL。本文档只定义 13 个操作，不应假设其他 AdsPower 路由存在。`browserCookies` 以及 `userList` 的 `fp_verdict`/`fp_captured_at` 字段是 IDFRI 扩展。

通过认证后，兼容路由使用 HTTP 200 和 `{ code, msg, data }` JSON 包装；成功时 `code` 为 `0`、`msg` 为 `"success"`，业务失败时 `code` 为 `-1`。浏览器控制路由忽略 HTTP 方法；分组与用户路由要求文档指定的方法。

每个操作保留 `x-aliasmode-version-introduced` 兼容字段，表示该兼容契约最早覆盖的上游版本。IDFRI 本地版不提供 Cloud 路由或 Cloud 协调器。

servers.description: IDFRI 回环监听器。仅限本机，必须使用每次启动生成的 Bearer Token。

tags.name: browser
tags.description: Start, stop, and inspect a profile's browser.

tags.name: group
tags.description: 资料分组。IDFRI 不使用独立分组 ID，因此 ID 等于名称。

tags.name: user
tags.description: 使用 AdsPower `user` 词汇管理资料；`user_id` 即 IDFRI 资料 ID。

get.description: `/status` 是 AdsPower Local API 的兼容路径。IDFRI 运行时返回 `code: 0`；启用生命周期并发控制时，`data.admission` 包含计数器。
Same response as `/status`. May include `data.admission` statistics when admission control is configured.
启动资料的 IDFRI Chromium（实验兼容内核），或返回已运行实例。`data.ws.puppeteer` 是自动化客户端使用的 CDP WebSocket URL，可完全控制浏览器，请勿记录或分享。未知资料返回 `no such profile: <id>`。

parameters.name: launch_args
parameters.description: URL-encoded JSON array of extra browser command-line arguments. Non-array or invalid JSON is ignored.

200.description: Success envelope with the CDP endpoint, or a failure envelope.

get.description: Captures session state and closes the browser. Returns `code: 0` with empty `data` once teardown is confirmed. Fails with `browser teardown unconfirmed: <id>` when the process could not be confirmed stopped.

200.description: Success envelope with empty `data`, or a failure envelope.

get.summary: Check whether a profile's browser is running
get.description: `status` is `Active` or `Inactive`. `lifecycle` reports a transition (`starting`, `stopping`) or `uncertain` when ownership-safe teardown is unconfirmed; `running` accompanies a certified live browser. `ws` is present only for `lifecycle: running`.

200.description: Success envelope with the browser state, or a failure envelope (missing `user_id`).

post.description: Trims the on-disk browser caches of the given profiles so user-data directories do not grow without bound. Compatibility clients fire-and-forget this after each session with `type: ["image_file"]`; `type` is accepted and ignored. Always returns `code: 0`; a missing or malformed body clears nothing.

get.summary: Read cookies from a running browser (IDFRI extension)
get.description: IDFRI 对 AdsPower API 的扩展。通过 Playwright `context.cookies()` 读取给定 URL 的 Cookie。资料浏览器必须安全运行；Cookie 值属于会话凭据，必须妥善保护。

parameters.name: urls
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of URLs whose cookies to return. Defaults to `https://x.com,https://twitter.com`.

200.description: Success envelope with the cookie list, or a failure envelope.

get.description: Returns one page of group names. `group_id` equals `group_name` because AliasMode has no separate group ids. AdsPower's ungrouped id `"0"` maps to `""` and is never listed. Empty groups registered with `groupCreate` are included.

post.description: Registers a group so it lists before its first profile exists. Idempotent: the returned `group_id` equals the trimmed `group_name`. Fails with `invalid JSON body` or `missing group_name`.

200.description: Success envelope with the group id, or a failure envelope.

get.description: Returns one page of profiles in AdsPower's row shape. Filter with `group_id` (`"0"` or `""` selects ungrouped profiles). Sort with `user_sort`. Timestamps are Unix seconds; `0` means unknown or never opened. `fp_verdict` and `fp_captured_at` are AliasMode additions: the fingerprint attestation verdict and capture time, or `""` when no attestation exists.

parameters.name: group_id
parameters.description: Only profiles in this group. `0` or an empty string selects ungrouped profiles.

parameters.name: user_sort
parameters.description: JSON object with one key, `created_time` or `last_open_time`, whose value is `asc` or `desc`. Malformed JSON keeps insertion order.

post.description: Creates an AliasMode profile from an AdsPower-shaped payload. A blank `name` is replaced by the generated profile id. `group_id` `"0"` means ungrouped. `fingerprint_config.screen_resolution` uses AdsPower's `WIDTH_HEIGHT` form; omit it for a realistic random resolution. When a proxy is given, the browser timezone is matched to the proxy's location on a best-effort basis. Fails with `invalid JSON body` or the validation error.

200.description: Success envelope with the new profile id, or a failure envelope.

post.description: Stops each profile's browser, removes its browser data, and deletes the profile. Unknown ids are skipped. Profiles whose browser could not be stopped are left in place and returned in `locked`. Fails only with `invalid JSON body`.

200.description: Success envelope with counts, or a failure envelope.

post.summary: Rename a profile and update its saved credentials
post.description: `name` is required and replaces the profile name. Credential fields are applied only when present as strings. Fails with `invalid JSON body`, `missing user_id`, `name must be a non-empty string`, `no such profile: <id>`, or `failed to persist profile update: <reason>`.

200.description: Success envelope with empty `data`, or a failure envelope.

bearerAuth.description: 使用 IDFRI 本次启动生成的 Local API Token。

UserId.name: user_id
UserId.description: IDFRI 资料 ID（AdsPower `user_id`）。缺失时返回 `missing user_id`。

Page.name: page
Page.description: 1-based page number. Non-positive or non-numeric values fall back to 1.

PageSize.name: page_size
PageSize.description: Rows per page. Non-positive or non-numeric values fall back to 100.

Envelope.description: Every Local API response. HTTP status is always 200; `code` carries the outcome.

msg.description: `success` on success, otherwise the failure reason.

Failure.description: Failure envelope. `msg` explains the reason; `data` is always empty. Unknown routes return `unknown route: <path>`.

AdmissionStats.description: Lifecycle admission counters, present only when admission control is configured.

puppeteer.description: CDP WebSocket URL (`ws://127.0.0.1:<port>/devtools/browser/<id>`). Grants full control of the browser; treat it as a secret.

selenium.description: Always empty. AliasMode exposes CDP only.

debug_port.description: Remote debugging port as a decimal string.

webdriver.description: Always empty. AliasMode ships no WebDriver binary.

warning.description: 上游 Cloud 兼容保留字段；IDFRI 本地版不会返回此字段。

lifecycle.description: Present with `Active`. `running` means a certified live browser; the other values describe a transition or unconfirmed teardown.

profile_id.description: One profile id or a list of ids.

type.description: AdsPower cache categories such as `image_file`. Accepted for compatibility and ignored; AliasMode clears its disk caches.

expires.description: Unix seconds. `-1` or absent for session cookies.

group_name.description: Group name; surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

fp_verdict.description: AliasMode addition: fingerprint attestation verdict, or `""` when no attestation exists.

fp_captured_at.description: AliasMode addition: attestation capture time as an ISO 8601 string, or `""`.

ProxyConfig.description: AdsPower `user_proxy_config`. Ignored unless `proxy_host` is a non-empty string.

proxy_port.description: Port as a string. Numbers are accepted and converted.

UserCreateRequest.description: AdsPower-shaped profile payload. All fields are optional; unknown fields are ignored. Prefer the snake_case credential names; `emailPassword` and `twofa` are accepted aliases.

name.description: Profile name. Blank names become the generated id.

group_id.description: Group name. `0` or empty means ungrouped.

domain_name.description: Platform the account belongs to, for example `x.com`.

id.description: New profile id. Use it as `user_id` elsewhere.

user_ids.description: Profile ids to delete. A non-array value deletes nothing.

locked.description: Profile ids kept because their browser could not be stopped.

name.description: New profile name. Required and non-empty.
